thread.title: Amazon narrows Microsoft's market-cap lead to under $23 billion

author: Tomi Kilgore
title: Amazon narrows Microsoft's market-cap lead to under $23 billion
text: Amazon.com Inc.'s stock AMZN, +2.27% ran up 2.2% toward a fifth-straight record close, to close the gap between the e-commerce behemoth's market-capitalization and that of the software-giant Microsoft Corp. MSFT, +2.02% to just $22.5 billion. Amazon's market cap has soared 25.5% in 2018, to boost its market cap by about $143.78 billion to $707.31 billion from $563.53 billion at the end of 2017. Meanwhile, Microsoft shares have gained 10.6% this year, lifting the market cap to $729.76 billion from $659.91 at the end of December. Amazon is still well behind No.-2 Google parent Alphabet Inc. GOOGL, +0.38% which is currently valued at $821.18 billion, and behind No.-1 Apple Inc. AAPL, +0.19% at $849.77 billion. Meanwhile, Amazon founder Jeff Bezos' wealth has already surpassed that of Microsoft founder Bill Gates, as the Bloomberg Billionaires Index has Bezos worth $120 billion and Gates worth just $94.6 billion. Amazon shares have soared 33% over the past three months, while Microsoft's stock has climbed 14% and the Dow Jones Industrial Average DJIA, +0.70% has gained 12%.
